name: vox-crewlove-drake-4-delay-return
notes: Crew Love (Drake) vocal chain, stock Delay on a return at 100% wet: unsynced 264 ms, linked, feedback 49%, filter on at 1.2 kHz (dark repeats). Vocal track send to this return: -25 dB (DiffVox put the delay about 25 dB under the direct vocal). In the model the delay also feeds the reverb at about 40%; not wired here. Only the listed params were set; others are Delay defaults. Apply to a return device by name (save_plugin_recipe cannot snapshot return tracks).
